title.ja: 仁義なき排泄 / デスレース2010
title.en: Excretion Without Honor and Humanity / Death Race 2010

1.overview: Panty and Stocking are sent to investigate several cases of people getting eaten by toilets, which are caused by a ghost bent on covering Daten City in feces.
1.summary:
Panty gets funky after a twisted trip down the toilet! Later, the Anarchy Sisters must work together to bring a speed demon`s reign of terror to a screeching halt!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ミツバチのざわめき / セックス・アンド・ザ・ダテンシティ
title.en: The Turmoil of the Beehive / Sex and the Daten City
title.ko: 꿀벌의 웅성거림 / 섹스 앤드 더 다텐 시티
title.x-jat: Mitsubachi no Zawameki / Sex and the Daten City

2.overview: Panty and Stocking chase after a ghost with the ability to possess vehicles. However, Panty's underwear (which transform into her weapon) get stuck on the ghost's head, making it difficult to get them back without damaging them.
2.summary:
When the Anarchy Sisters go back to school, Panty starts a cat fight with the demonic queen bee of Daten High. Too bad the fallen angel`s celebrity status is suddenly squashed by a scandalous home video!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: キャットファイト・クラブ / パルプ・アディクション

3.overview: While investigating a series of disappearances at Daten City High School, Panty and Stocking encounter Queen Barby, the cheerleading team captain whose reign as the most popular student is threatened by the Anarchy sisters. With the help of the teenage occult geek Brief, Panty and Stocking expose Barby as the Ghost behind the school's disappearances.
3.summary:
An argument over heavenly pudding threatens to end the scandalous partnership of Panty and Stocking. In other news, Garter Belt gets backed up when an army of potent demons take over the tissue factory!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ダイエット・シンドローム / ハイスクール・ヌーディカル
title.en: The Diet Syndrome / High School Nudical

4.overview: At the preview of her and Stocking's first feature film, Panty screens a pornographic film she once starred in, which leaks to the public. With her celebrity lifestyle at risk, Panty travels the world with Stocking and destroys every copy of the porn in existence save for one, which the sisters decide to keep for themselves. But when Panty reveals she edited out all of Stocking's scenes in their film, Stocking gets revenge by uploading the last porn copy online.
4.summary:
Demonic cream-filled pastries turn Stocking into the widest of wide loads, and Panty plays naughty when Garter Belt’s lingerie run runs out of lingerie! Poor Brief may never recover.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ハナムプトラ / ヴォミッティング・ポイント
title.en: Raiders of the Nasal Dark / Vomiting Point

5.overview: Panty and Stocking get into a heated argument over a missing cup of pudding and go their separate ways. However, they are forced to put their differences aside to defeat a pair of Ghosts who work as a team.
5.summary:
Disgusting bodily fluids are the story of the hour when Panty falls hard for a demon with a nostril fetish, and some loser pukes up a wretched vomit monster!
Source: crunchyroll

6.overview: The Ghosts of vengeful sperm cause a shortage of tissue paper, rendering the men in Daten City incapable of wiping themselves after ejaculating.
6.summary:
Panty and Stocking are shocked to find their social status plummeting when the demonic duo known as Scanty and Kneesocks try and take over the school!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: トランスホーム / 現金に裸体を張れ
title.x-jat: Transhomers / Genkin ni Ratai o Bare

7.overview: Stocking finds herself gaining weight and goes on an intense diet, but she only keeps getting fatter until she balloons into a giant. When the cause is revealed to be from an obese Ghost who refuses to diet, Stocking sets out for revenge. Upon defeating the Ghost, Stocking returns to her original figure.
7.summary:
Prepare yourself for a battle between the Pantybots and the Stockingcons in this blatant rip-off of a cartoon classic! Next on the agenda, Panty and Stocking trade their clothes for cash!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ...オブ・ザ・デッド / 一匹の怒れるゴースト
title.ko: ...오브 더 데드 / 한 마리의 두려워하는 고스트
title.x-jat: ... of the Dead / Ippiki no Okoreru Ghost

8.overview: Daten City High School holds a lingerie run in which participants must race in their underwear. The run is interrupted by a Ghost who eats underwear, including Panty and Stocking's weapons, so Panty must resort to using whatever underwear she can find.
8.summary:
Panty and Stocking use a wicked assortment of sex toys to eradicate an army of the undead. When the dust settles, the foul-mouthed sisters find themselves on trial for ghost murder with a monkey for an attorney!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 天使が水着に着替えたら / ゴースト ~ダテンシティの幻~
title.en: If the Angels Wore Swimsuits / Ghost: The Phantom of Daten City
title.ko: 천사가 수영복으로 갈아입으면 / 고스트 ~다텐 시티의 환상~
title.x-jat: Tenshi ga Mizugi ni Kigaetara / Ghost: Daten City no Maboroshi

9.overview: A recreational nose-picking fad spreads across Daten City thanks to a man named Oscar H. Genius, who invites the citizens of Daten City to a blimp party. However, Genius turns out to be a Ghost intent on ramming the blimp into the moon using the passengers' collective nosebleeds.
9.summary:
Panty and Stocking take on Scanty and Kneesocks in a scandalous beach volleyball tournament. On the flip side, Stocking falls in love with a super stinky ghost!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: インナーブリーフ / チャック・トゥ・ザ・フューチャー / チャック・トゥ・ザ・フューチャー PART2 / チャック・トゥ・ザ・フューチャー PART3 / HELP! 二人はエンジェル
title.en: Inner Brief / Chuck to the Future
title.ko: 이너 브리프 / 척 투 더 퓨처 / 척 투 더 퓨처 PART 2 / 척 투 더 퓨처 PART 3 / HELP! 두 사람은 엔젤
title.x-jat: Inner Brief / Chuck to the Future / Chuck to the Future Part 2 / Chuck to the Future Part 3 / Help! Futari wa Angel

10.overview: In the gloomy town of Little Tokyo neighboring Daten City, a struggling office worker named Terao is denied his chance to attend his young daughter's birthday party and forced by his co-workers to drink a mountain of beer, causing him to create a Ghost made of vomit. Panty and Stocking defeat the Ghost and decide to help Terao with his troubles by giving him their autographs as a present for his daughter, who is an avid fan of the Anarchy sisters.
10.summary:
Panty and Stocking shrink down and get swallowed by a boy, Chuck goes on a mind-bending, three-part adventure, and a scandalous music video featuring the Anarchy Sisters rocks the house!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ワンス・アポン・ア・タイム・イン・ガーターベルト / ナッシング・トゥ・ルーム
title.en: Once Upon a Time... in Garterbelt / Nothing to Room
title.ko: 원스 어폰 어 타임 인 가터벨트 / 나띵 두 룸
title.x-jat: Once Upon a Time in Garterbelt / Nothing to Room

11.overview: Panty and Stocking arrive at school to find that a strict academic regime has been established by the mayor's daughters, the Demon sisters Scanty and Kneesocks, and are banished to the lowest class in school. Together with Brief, Panty and Stocking discover that Scanty and Kneesocks are demons who are running a factory that produces an army of fake Ghosts beneath the school. A destructive battle ensues, with the Anarchy sisters defeating the Daemon sisters by destroying the stone that powers the factory.
11.summary:
Everyone’s favorite foul-mouthed angels sneak into Garter Belt’s secret dungeon and read his diary. For an encore, the scandalous divas sit on the couch and bitch about being hungry!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: D.C.コンフィデンシャル / パンティ+ブリーフ

12.overview: Panty and Stocking's sibling feud escalates into all-out war when they eat the cores of two warring alien robots and transform into robots themselves. When the alien robots decide to join forces to destroy the human race and merge into a Ghost, Panty and Stocking are once again forced to work together to defeat the Ghost.
12.summary:
After an exhilarating rundown of the Anarchy Sisters’ greatest kills, the world grinds to a halt when Stocking returns to heaven, and Panty discovers she’s no longer capable of copulating!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ビッチガールズ / ビッチガールズ2ビッチ

13.overview: Garterbelt gets angry at Panty and Stocking for wasting money, so the sisters make a bet to raise $3 million in three days. Getting jobs proves difficult for them, so they resort to going to a casino run by Scanty and Kneesocks, who rig their games to ensure the angels will lose. The Anarchy sisters eventually run out of money, but by selling their clothes to onlookers, they manage to play long enough to break through the Demon sisters' scheme and earn their $3 million.
13.summary:
Panty must find a way to lose her holy hymen if she wants to keep Brief’s member from unlocking the beast known as Hellmonkey! Too bad Stocking isn’t around to lend a hand.
Source: crunchyroll
